'''Carnovian eel''' was a species of gigantic [[Eel/Legends|eels]] that inhabited the deep [[Water/Legends|waters]] of the planet [[Carnovia]]. The pups of these eels were eaten by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as a snack and were raised in pens by Hutt [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

==Biology and appearance==
These gigantic [[Eel/Legends|eels]] prowled the depths of [[Water/Legends|water]] bodies in humid habitats.<ref name="EA" /> Immature eels were prized as snacks by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and were raised in shallow or deep-water pens by Hutt [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on Carnovia.<ref name="EA" /><ref name="LH" />

==History==
{{Quote|A bit like a Carnovian eel-pup, but with just a hint of the resistance one expects from the finest nala-tree frogs supplied by Fhnark and Company. All in all, on a par with some of the classic droch appetizers fashioned by Zubindi Ebsuk|Borga Besadii Diori evaluates the taste of a Yuuzhan Vong life-form|<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>}}
Originally, these [[Eel/Legends|eels]] hailed from the depths of the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Carnovia]],<ref name="EA" /> located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EA" /><ref name="LH" /> Several thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Declaration of the New Order|proclamation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] [[Vermilic]] emerged and established its base for its own operations on the humid planet Carnovia. Over the course of their operations, the Vermilic clan brought recognition to Carnovia for its [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] production, especially eel [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. Even Vermilic's [[Floating Palace|palace]] sat at the center of a great lake, surrounded by numerous pens for Carnovian eels.<ref name="LH" />

Immature Carnovian eels<ref name="RD" /><ref name="EA" /> were prized as popular snacks among Hutts, and their labor-intensive farming required many slaves. As such, the Vermilic operations relied on a tried-and-true Hutt tradition: [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor.<ref name="LH" /> After being harvested, the eel pups were placed into bowls, from which Hutts popped the squirming, squeaking morsels into their [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]].<ref name="RD" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], [[Borga Besadii Diori]] conducted business negotiations with representatives of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. As a gift, the guests brought a tank containing a variety of fish-sized life-forms created by their biotechnology. The taste of several of the creatures Borga consumed reminded her of a combination of familiar delicacies, somewhat similar to Carnovian eel pups.<ref name="NJO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carnovian eel was first appeared in the novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', published in [[1998]], although no information about the creature itself was provided.<ref name="RD" /> More information about this being was later presented in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''<ref name="EA" /> and the sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', released in [[2015]].<ref name="LH" />
